BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tᵉqal where it means to balance, to weigh. In Daniel 5:25, this is the writing that was written, and it appears again in Daniel 5:27.
TheologicalSignificance: Belshazzar weighed in the balances and found wanting makes me ask how my own life would measure up before God.
